name: OpenPost

var_descriptions.openpost.OPENPOST_APP_URL: Public HTTPS origin of OpenPost; OAuth callbacks, passkeys and CORS derive from it. Update for a custom domain
var_descriptions.openpost.OPENPOST_PUBLIC_URL: Public base URL used for media links that social networks fetch; keep equal to the app URL
var_descriptions.openpost.OPENPOST_JWT_SECRET: Generated key that signs login tokens
var_descriptions.openpost.OPENPOST_ENCRYPTION_KEY: Generated key that encrypts stored social-account tokens; keep it stable

title: OpenPost (Self-Hosted Social Media Scheduler)
short_desc: Self-hosted social scheduler for X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky
icon_note: mdi/calendar-send (neutral; upstream logo reuse not checked)
angle: A single-container, Buffer-style social scheduler you own: schedule posts to X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and more from one calendar, with a media library, built-in image/video editors and an MCP server for AI agents. SQLite + media live on one volume, so there is no database service; zero inputs, generated JWT and encryption keys. Different app from the existing Postiz template (smaller, single container, no Postgres/Redis/Temporal).
notes: Official image v7.42.2 unmodified except USER root (needed to write the Railway volume; upstream runs as 'openpost'). Upstream already bakes OPENPOST_PORT=8080, EDITION=selfhost, SQLite at /data/db and media at /data/media. First registered user becomes the instance admin and registration stays open afterwards (admins can restrict it in Settings, Instance); register right after deploying. Connecting social accounts needs the user's own provider app credentials (Settings, Instance, Configuration), none are required to boot. Email (verification/reset) is not configured. AGPL-3.0, not affiliated with OpenPost.
